# M PLUS Rounded 1c — 700

Used for LP headings and the tagline, with CSS family alias `Plus Rounded`. This is a complementary Japanese typeface, not an identification of the font in the supplied logo.

Official family: https://fonts.google.com/specimen/M+PLUS+Rounded+1c
Font delivery source: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=M+PLUS+Rounded+1c:wght@700&display=swap
License source: https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/roundedmplus1c/OFL.txt

The public WOFF2 subsets are stored locally, without changing the font binaries. `unicode-range` lets the browser request only the subsets required by text using this family. No visitor request to Google Fonts is needed. The license and copyright notice are included in `OFL-MPLUSRounded1c.txt`.
